main_text.l: Ea enim si probè calleant, fa-

marginalia.note: Joh. Ma-gnus Gothor. Hi-stor. l. 2. cap. 28:

page.notes: The printed page is 44, with the running head "P. VOET". The marginal note is set in small type in the left margin; its line breaks are kept by the hyphens, and "Gothor." is written whole because the line ends with "Go" and no hyphen is printed. The paragraph runs over from the previous page and continues to the catchword "Pru-". No doubtful readings. The faint mark at the lower right is a digitiser's watermark and is not transcribed.
